title: Rock Paper Scissors Shoot
description: a Minecraft Forge/Fabric Mod that add the real life game Rock Paper Scissors into Minecraft
body:
Rock Paper Scissors Shoot is a Minecraft mod that adds a full Rock, Paper, Scissors game with an in-game UI, player invites, and result screens.

# How To Use

### To start

Type `/rockpaperscissersshoot` to open a menu where you can invite players. Once a player joins, you’ll play Rock, Paper, Scissors.

### How it works

You have three options: Rock, Paper, and Scissors. After you choose, an animation plays showing the winner. Then a results menu appears with text showing who won, plus two buttons: Try Again or Exit Match.
